summary: scripts/ci-local gives every test process a short TMPDIR of its own on disk, so a test that leaves an empty .git in its temporary directory can no longer fail the tests that run after it, and the tests' Unix socket paths fit their 108-byte limit

replay.detail: No graph, claim or storage change.

compatibility.detail: CI is unchanged: the target runner is set only inside scripts/ci-local. The commands the stages run and the notes they sign are unchanged.
